title: Grateful Dead Live at Palace Theater on 1972-09-24
source: Recording Info: SBD > MR > ? > C > DAT > SHN; Transfer Info: SHN > TLH > WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > FLAC; Tracked, patched and mastered by Bill Guarneri, July 28, 2014

ai_review.summary: High‑energy ’72 show with urgent jams and a solid soundboard capture despite minor dropouts.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its urgency, especially on Playing in the Band, Dark Star > China Cat Sunflower > The Other One > Rider, and a fiery Sugar Magnolia. The soundboard source is generally clear, though reviewers note a few noticeable drop‑outs and overly forward vocals on Weir and Phil. Overall the show feels creative and energetic.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are high (4–5 stars) and highlight strong musical moments; recording issues are minor, resulting in a solid combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Minor but noticeable drop‑outs on the Jed & Playing in the Band reprise and near the end of I Know You Rider; vocals (especially Weir) are mixed very high, Phil's vocal presence is also prominent.

standout_songs: Dark Star > China Cat Sunflower > The Other One > Rider
poor_songs: Dark Star > China Cat Sunflower > Rider (did not live up to hype for some listeners)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Creative set list with strong transitions; high‑energy first half leading into an adventurous second set.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's vocals are mixed over the top; reviewer urges more Phil singing.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir's vocal level is pushed way up in the mix, noted as 'up to 11'.
